title: Old Fisherman's Wharf

services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Cruise Monterey Bay and observe the sea otters, seals, pelicans and other bay life. Experience adventures on the high seas where you can participate in deep sea fishing or catch a glimpse of migrating gray whales. Go for a peaceful sailing cruise. Fisherman's Wharf has it all. Fun for the whole family! Note: many whale watching companies are open daily throughout the holiday season except Christmas Day. Updated “Whale Alert” iPad, iPhone app invites public to contribute to protection of West Coast whales. For more information, click here. We offer full service guided Family Friendly whale watching tours year around in the third largest deep submarine canyon in the world. Learn More...
